new_theorem.statement: Let K be the q-dimensional bottom right-singular subspace of F=G0^(1/2)L. With a=s_(m-q)(F)>0, b=inf_{x in K,||x||=1}||Wx||>0, c=||W P_(K^perp)||op and S=a^2+b^2+c^2, define rho^2=(S-sqrt(S^2-4a^2b^2))/2. Then s_m((A0+E)P)>=rho>=ab/sqrt(S). If later additions satisfy S0P=0 and ||TP||<=epsilon, then s_m(AP)>=[rho-epsilon]_+.
